subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and cross-channel explicit multi-bot mention semantics, or keep this work split across memory-plugin APIs and channel-specific fixes?
rationale: The requested behavior changes memory authority, persisted rule storage, workspace file precedence, and channel delivery semantics, and current main has useful pieces but no settled product contract for the proposed layer.

options.title: Keep As Design Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

options.title: Split The Work
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72504 and Feishu PRs for the message-loss subset, and open or refine a separate memory-governance design only if maintainers want the durable rule layer.

options.title: Route Through Plugin/API Design
options.body: Require the durable rule-learning capability to prove it cannot be built through memory/plugin APIs before adding core rule-layer surface.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-line history across the memory, prompt/context, and Feishu boundaries involved in the product decision.
